$comment: Vanilla API tables of components without a create<Name> controller (leadAmendments A6). Step 30 compares such a table with the classes and data-*/aria-* attributes that the '## Stable class and state API' table of the @hawiyah/styles README documents for the component's classes (components.json cssClasses), plus a row 'class'. Attributes defined by HTML or ARIA have no machine-readable Hawiyah declaration and are listed under nativeAttributes; documented attributes the page leaves out are listed under notListed. Requiredness is not checked for these tables, because the contract declares none. Every entry needs a reason and the lead's review.

vanilla.reason: Button is a native button element styled by the class hw-button; @hawiyah/vanilla 0.3.0 exports no createButton.

nativeAttributes.type: HTML attribute of the button element; the page lists it because the browser default in a form is submit.
nativeAttributes.disabled: HTML attribute of the button element; the loading state uses it.
nativeAttributes.aria-busy: ARIA attribute; the loading state writes aria-busy="true" with disabled.
